description: Read the Arx admin account watch for a WordPress site: the admin-capable accounts OMA expects (status expected) and the ones that appeared or got admin rights outside OMA (status unexpected, with how, address and time in detail), audit flags per admin (never_logged_in, inactive_90d, disposable_email, generic_login, app_passwords), application passwords (name, created, last used; never the password) and the app password policy (all, admins, off), and the must-use plugins and drop-ins (advanced-cache.php, db.php, object-cache.php...) with known installer or unknown. The list is read straight from the site's database, so admins written in by SQL show up too.
name: oma_arx_admin_watch
title: Arx admin accounts
